sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Broadband low-end onset ~150 ms after the panel settles with nothing changing on screen; matches the recurring music hits (CLAP top label is music). The rising tick series inside the event box (22.3-22.6 s) is not a candidate.

pattern.description: A floating tweaks panel grows downward to reveal a Network section; each control row (header, sliders, checkboxes) fades in while sliding left from a staggered indent, as the camera tilts down to follow.
pattern.why_premium: Rows land in a tight cascade instead of popping as a block, and the camera tilt tracks the growing panel so the eye rides the reveal; the faint rising tick series in the audio appears synced to the stagger.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.tweaks', {clipPath: 'inset(0 0 100% 0)'}, {clipPath: 'inset(0 0 0% 0)', duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out'}); tl.fromTo('.tweaks .row', {x: 24, opacity: 0}, {x: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0.04}, '<0.05'); camera: tl.to('.stage', {y: -60, scale: 0.96, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.inOut'}, '<').
build_hint.remotion: per row i: const p = spring({frame: frame - i*1, fps, config: {damping: 26, stiffness: 180}}); style={{opacity: p, transform: `translateX(${(1-p)*24}px)`}}; panel height via interpolate(frame, [0, 10], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic)}); stage translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 12], [0, -60]).

notes: City size row and Show arcs checkbox have no own candidate box (covered only by the large b04/b01 regions); they follow the same stagger. Camera verdict is tilt_down with slight scale-down.
